evidence.result: FAIL as predeclared: 256x256 RGBA gradient to 64 colours at --quality 70-95 exits 99 (MSE Q=54, floor 70); no palette written. Unrecorded diagnostic at --quality 0-100: exit 0, 14817 B vs 1754 B source, alpha 3/255..244/255, PSNR 31.17 dB.
evidence.scope: Fixture-reported: q70 floor fails for 256px RGBA gradient at 64 colours (exit 99, Q=54); no palette written. Says nothing on alpha or size; macOS arm64 only.

summary: CLI library for lossy PNG palette quantization with alpha; trades colour precision for smaller indexed PNG files.
use_when: When smaller palette PNGs justify controlled colour loss
When alpha transparency must remain available
